answer_1.quote: Constrained commonsense generation. Given a set of concepts such as "dog, frisbee, catch, throw", the task is to generate a coherent sentence describing an everyday scenario such as "a man throws a frisbee and his dog catches it".
answer_1.outputs: coherent sentences describing everyday scenarios, explanations for why a counterfactual statement does not make sense

answer_2.quote: The task is evaluated by SPICE , BLEU-4 , ROUGE-L , CIDEr , in which SPICE is the primary metric for leaderboard ranking.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 50 generated outputs from the CommonGen dev set (as the test set is not public) and 50 generated outputs from the ComVE test set. All evaluations were conducted on Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT), and each evaluation form was answered by three AMT workers.
answer_4.guideline: The generated outputs are evaluated by fluency and accuracy. Fluency is assessed on the grammatical correctness and readability of the generated outputs disregarding the input text. Besides, accuracy evaluates whether the output generated is correct and reasonable given the input text of each task.
